description: Publish a concise owner answer. For researched facts include direct source links and evidence entries: actual page URL, exact short quote, primary/secondary attribution. First-party status requires checking publisher and current version, not a page saying official. For a checked monitor include observation status and stable event_key; the kernel suppresses unchanged/pending observations. accepted means saved, not delivered or task completion. Widgets suspend execution until one validated owner response.
